ruleDefinitions.name: PUA - Advanced IP/Port Scanner Update Check
ruleDefinitions.description: Detect the update check performed by Advanced IP/Port Scanner utilities. Note: Unmapped fields: c-uri, c-uri-query

sequences.query: (c-uri = RGX(".*\\/checkupdate\\\.php.*") AND (c-uri-query = RGX(".*lng\\=.*") AND c-uri-query = RGX(".*ver\\=.*") AND c-uri-query = RGX(".*beta\\=.*") AND c-uri-query = RGX(".*type\\=.*") AND c-uri-query = RGX(".*rmode\\=.*") AND c-uri-query = RGX(".*product\\=.*")))
